Definition: from G2740; to set on fire:--fervent heat.
BiblicalUsage: Kausoo means to burn with fervent heat, to set on fire. 2 Peter 3:10 says the elements shall melt with fervent heat on the day of the Lord, and 2 Peter 3:12 says the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this world is not forever: it will melt, and only what God remakes will stand.
RelatedTopics: Day of the Lord; Second Coming
